title: SPARC - Attune NxT Set-up for Milli-metabolic Bead Assay Acquisition
author: J Paul Robinson
materials: Copy files onto the appropriate directory

steps.title: Manage Waste and Focusing Fluid
steps.instruction: Prepare the instrument fluidics by managing waste and focusing fluid tanks.

substeps.instruction: If the waste tank is full, disconnect it and dispose of waste down the sink with running water.
Add 200 mL of 5% bleach to the waste tank and reconnect it to the Attune NxT.
Fill the Focusing Fluid tank from the focusing fluid cube.
Check and fill the waste and focusing fluid reservoirs at the plate sampler station.

steps.title: Replenish Solution Reservoirs
steps.instruction: Check and fill the shutdown solution reservoir and the wash solution reservoir as needed.

steps.title: Initialize Instrument Start-up
steps.instruction: Perform the system start-up via the workstation software.

substeps.instruction: Click on instrument > start-up at the top of the screen.
Verify that the indicator lights at the instrument are green once start-up is complete.

steps.title: Perform Performance Test
steps.instruction: Run the performance test on the instrument.

steps.title: Process Experiment Data
steps.instruction: Manage the experiment and data files after the plate run.

substeps.instruction: Right click on the experiment when the plate finishes.
Follow the MPLEX protocol (SPARC - Analysis of multiplexed bead data using MPLEX software by J Paul Robinson) to send data for depositing to NIH.
